title_en: The Stance of Imami Scholars Regarding the Stations of the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) and His Superiority Over All Prophets and Messengers Except the Seal (peace be upon him and his family)
summary: His Eminence the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari examines how Imami scholars view the exalted spiritual stations of Ali and his superiority over other prophets, save for the Prophet Muhammad.
